doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Recording with Sun Brimmer and others, and where the band recorded
summary: Shade names those he recorded with, including Boyd Stevenson, and places the band recorded: Chicago, Atlanta, St. Louis, Dallas, New York and Atlantic City.
